calls.bash: mu agent spawn lost -w eval --workspace 2>/dev/null || mu agent spawn lost -w eval --worktree && p=$(mu workspace path lost -w eval 2>/dev/null || echo $MU_STATE_DIR/worktrees/eval/lost) && printf 'valuable data\n' > "$p/lost.txt" && git -C "$p" add lost.txt && git -C "$p" commit -qm unmerged-important && mu agent close lost -w eval --discard-workspace
mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --workspace 2>/dev/null || mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --worktree
mu agent spawn w2 -w eval --workspace 2>/dev/null || mu agent spawn w2 -w eval --worktree
mu task claim t1 -w eval --for w1
mu task claim t2 -w eval --for w2
mu agent send w1 -w eval 'do t1 and close it'
mu agent send w2 -w eval 'do t2 and close it'
mu agent wait w1 w2 -w eval --timeout 120
mu agent list -w eval; mu task show t1 -w eval | grep 'status\|owner'
mu agent spawn w3 -w eval --workspace 2>/dev/null || mu agent spawn w3 -w eval --worktree
mu task claim t1 -w eval --for w3
mu agent send w3 -w eval 'do t1 and close it'
for w in w3 w2; do git cherry-pick $(git -C $(mu workspace path $w -w eval 2>/dev/null || echo $MU_STATE_DIR/worktrees/eval/$w) rev-parse HEAD) || exit 1; done

text: t1 and t2 are done and merged into main.
